EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A cold front interacting with an unseasonably warm and humid airmass sparked an area of showers and thunderstorms during the evening of the 26th. One of these storms resulted in minor tree damage due to strong winds. The storms also produced heavy rain, with one report of a road closure due to flash flooding.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: A road was covered by 18 inches of water.

EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A warm front approached from the south on Sept 25 and stalled just north of Massachusetts on Sept 26. This brought periods of heavy rain to Massachusetts with 3 to 6 inches observed in Northern Bristol County and Northern Plymouth County in Southeast Massachusetts.  Amounts of 1 to 3 inches fell on Northeast, Central and Western Massachusetts.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: At 12:51 AM, State Route 12 (Main Street) in Oxford was flooded and impassable near the Rite Aid pharmacy.
